method: (t(32 tokens) - t(1 token)) / 31, batch 1, greedy, ignore_eos
command: sudo docker run --rm --device=/dev/kfd --device=/dev/dri --group-add video --ipc=host --shm-size 16g --security-opt seccomp=unconfined -v $HOME/models:/models -v $HOME/fleet-mi300x:/work -e VLLM_USE_V1=1 rocm/vllm:latest python3 /work/bench/vllm_decode_timing.py --model /models/dsv2-lite-base --golden /work/build/golden_tokens.txt --json /work/results/baseline_vllm.json

config.attention_backend: AITER MLA (rocm.py: Using AITER MLA backend)
config.quantization: none (bf16 weights; aiter pre-compiles fp8 BMM kernels but quant_fp8 op was reported absent from the model)

caveats: decode ms/token = (t(32)-t(1))/31 wall time through the LLM.generate API: includes vLLM's scheduler and sampler per step
vLLM's per-request metrics were None under V1, so no engine-internal decode timing
